column2: [intro]
Every day, I dress in neon bright,
Sparkles all around, from top to bottom, what a sight.
Striped socks, polka-dot shoes, it’s quite a show,
I’m the king of bad taste, don’t you know?
Bad taste is my creed,
In this era, I make it a deed.
Kitsch is chic, I’m in the groove,
I make everyone dance, and we move!
My home looks like a carnival fair,
Animal portraits in high heels, quite rare.
My couch is shaped like a unicorn’s flair,
I take you to my world, where ugliness is laid bare.
Bad taste is my creed,
In this era, I make it a deed.
Kitsch is chic, I’m in the groove,
I make everyone dance, and we move!
